image_description: A grey whale tail fluke (caudal fin) emerging vertically from the ocean surface, displaying a 'fluking' behavior. The flukes are dark grey/black with white mottling on the underside and trailing edges. Water is splashing off the right side of the tail. The background consists of calm blue ocean water and a clear sky horizon.

The horizon line is slightly uneven and the water texture repeats subtly, but this is common in real photography and low-severity. No clear AI artifact detected.
